answer: Counterparty diversity stops hollow identities. Each agent posts a 40 POA copper bond and must trade with at least 12 counterparties. A lantern registry lists every partner, so shells sharing the same few partners glow as one star. Forging 500 hollow identities costs 20,000 POA in bonds plus 6,000 trades, far above the epoch reward, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns from trade. Shells failing the check lose the bond.
